_comment: Smith per-project configuration. Seeded automatically on first SessionStart; safe to edit. Schema documented at .smith/config.json semantics in skills/smith-reflect/SKILL.md and skills/smith-ledger/SKILL.md. Delete any section to fall back to in-skill defaults.

question_gate._comment: question-gate-guard.sh suppresses the interactive AskUserQuestion popup in favor of Smith's markdown Q&A contract (see the smith-question skill). mode: deny (block the popup, redirect to markdown) | warn (allow + remind) | workflow-gated (deny only during an active Smith workflow) | off (inert). Absent key on a pre-existing project is treated as off (fail-open) until re-seeded.

context_budget._comment: context-budget-guard.sh warns (never blocks) when an edited file exceeds max_file_kb. @-referenced files (loaded in full every session) are flagged extra-loudly. Set max_file_kb to 0 to disable.
